selection_note: Three same-session examples selected for comparative development; this is not an unbiased performance sample.
privacy: Only scanner-generated setup evidence is included. Actual account fills, quantities, balances, returns and user messages are not included.
outcomes: No broker or simulated outcome labels are supplied in this public intake.

technical_checks.note: Rolling 20-bar VWAP, not full-session VWAP. Measurements are not a buy signal. Separate chart-led continuation: recent volume at least its earlier baseline; a completed news risk check is required, a fresh positive headline is not.

authoritative_plan.assumptions: Fictional EUR 500 allocation and assumed 40 bps round-trip costs. Not account funds or verified fees. Tick and quantity increments are unverified.
authoritative_plan.invalidation: Cancel if stop breaks before entry or any evidence expires. Exchange-session exit still needs verification.
authoritative_plan.loss_note: EUR 20 is planned loss under fixed stop fill and FX assumptions; gaps and slippage can increase actual loss.
authoritative_plan.trigger: Conditional break above prior five-bar high plus 10 bps; never enter after expiry.

cases.numeric_policy: Derive native levels from authoritative plan/FX; model narrative prices are not authoritative.

deduplication.treatment: Retain separately if needed; do not substitute it for the earlier setup or count it as an independent same-symbol success.

hypotheses.question: Does an exit after two consecutive completed five-minute closes below the original trigger improve net results versus the existing stop/target/session baseline?
controls: Both bars must begin after actual or explicitly simulated entry.
Observe an eligible quote after the second close; never execute at a historical candle close.
Keep hard stops, targets, expiry and session cutoff fixed.
Compare all eligible setups, including winners cut early and unresolved quotes.

hypotheses.question: Do pre-entry 20-bar momentum, distance from rolling VWAP and subsequent volume persistence distinguish continuation from failed breakouts?
controls: No threshold fitted to these three cases is promoted.
The recent 5-vs-15-bar volume ratio is not time-of-day adjusted.
Do not call rolling VWAP full-session VWAP.

validation.use: development only; hold out later dates before a changed policy is evaluated
